author: GameSpot
description:
Ubisoft is making some sweeping changes, from cancelling games like the Prince of Persia: Sands of Time Remake to delaying others like the rumoured Assassin's Creed 4: Black Flag Remake, to sorting its developers into Creative Houses. Lucy and Tam discuss these huge changes. 

#gaming #ubisoft #gamespot
title: The Future of Ubisoft Looks Bleak

author: GameSpot
description:
Dive into the world of Nioh 3 with this gameplay showcase demonstrating unique yokai, historical heroes, samurai and ninja-style combat, and the Crucible. 

"Conquer the Crucible, Become Shogun." 

The Nioh 3 demo launches January 29, 2026, on PlayStation®5 and Steam. Carry your save file to the full game. 

Complete the demo to receive the Twin-Snake Helmet reward when the game officially releases February 6, 2026.

Digital Pre-order Bonus: 
Hellfire Warrior Armor set
Hellfire Ninja Attire set
Scampuss Furball Netsuke Charm (accessory)
 
Early Purchase Bonus:
Hellfrost Warrior Armor set
Hellfrost Ninja Attire set
William (Nioh) Full Armor Set: Youngblood Armor (Samurai)
Hiddy (Nioh 2) Full Armor Set: Lone Wolf’s Armor (Ninja)

author: GameSpot
description:
Uncover the chilling history and twisted folklore of Tormentosa, a beautiful but malevolent island. Traverse eerie landscapes and take on monstrous foes as you peel back the layers of cults and blood sacrifice. Crisol: Theater of Idols is a gripping first

person horror/action adventure set in the haunting world of Hispania, a nightmarish reimagining of Spain. Playing as Gabriel, a soldier who can use his own blood as a deadly weapon, you endeavor on a journey to fulfill a divine mission from the Sun God.

#crisol #fps #horror #videogames
title: Crisol: Theater of Idols - Release Date Reveal Gameplay Trailer
